title: dk uv lock (1.0)
description: A reproducible, slot-aware lock of a solved PyPI dependency closure. Generated at author time by CommonsLang_Python.UvLock (from `uv lock`) and consumed at build time by CommonsLang_Python.UvBuild. The build only READS this file: it fetches each package's pinned artifact by URL, verifies the hash, and never solves or queries an index.

generated.description: Provenance; never read by the build.

indexes.description: The package index URLs uv resolved against (informational).

packages.description: Catalog of every resolved package, keyed "<name>.<version>".

slots.description: Per dk slot (e.g. Release.Windows_x86_64): the closure for that slot and the exact artifact chosen per package.

artifact.description: A wheel or sdist: the exact URL + hash used for an offline, verified fetch.

depends.description: Runtime dependency package names in the closure (informational for wheels; used for ordering only if an sdist ever needs a build backend).

wheels.description: All platform wheels uv recorded for this package; slots pick one.

python.description: The CPython X.Y this slot resolved for.

solution.description: The "<name>.<version>" keys forming this slot's closure.

artifacts.description: For each "<name>.<version>" in the solution, the exact artifact chosen for this slot (the platform-matched wheel, or the sdist as a fallback).
